This is a routine property inspection, not a repair. The inspection is already booked and the tenant has been told, so nothing more is needed until it happens on 13/02.

**Where the case stands**
- **What it is:** a periodic inspection at Flat 12, 162 Beacon Close, Cedarford, ZZ9 5ZZ. No repair has been reported, so I didn't create a maintenance ticket, book a contractor or ask the landlord for approval.
- **Booking:** 13/02/2024, 08:00–12:00. The tenant was sent an SMS and an email on 08/02, which is more than 24 hours' notice. They were told the inspector will take photos and that we'll use the management key if they're not home.
- **Records:** the property lookup found nothing, by address or by postcode. I used the case file as the record. Because there's no property ID, I couldn't check the tenancy or repair history.

**Problems with the attached report (not to be used yet)**
- **Wrong date:** the report says the inspection was on 16 Feb 2024 and was signed that day at 16:32. That is after today (08/02) and doesn't match the booked date of 13/02. It may be a draft, a template or the wrong file.
- **Different company name:** the report is from "Northbridge Lettings", but the tenant SMS was signed "Oakfield Services".
- **Doesn't look like a flat:** it describes stairs, 3 bedrooms, an en suite, a utility room and a garden. It should be checked against the right property.
- **No photos:** it records zero photos, even though the tenant was told photos would be taken.

The landlord should decide whether to accept it or have the door put back at the end of the tenancy.
- **Pets:** a small dog and a fish tank. We need to check these are allowed.
- **Wall marks:** sticker marks from command strips on the Bedroom 1 wall. The tenant has to remove them and repair the wall; it's a deposit matter, not a landlord repair.
- **Everything else:** all 11 areas rated Good for condition and cleanliness. Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms worked, and there was no damp, condensation or sign of smoking.

**What I did**
- Saved an internal note (NOTE-CA1620) with all of the above.
- Set the case status to "appointment booked" (STS-5B30D7), with a check date of 14/02.

I didn't escalate anything; none of this needs a human decision now.
